title: Wham Bam Shang-A-Lang
lyrics:

[00:21.20]You've loved all you can and now you're all loved out
[00:25.45]Ooh, ooh, baby, we've been a long, long way
[00:32.91]And who's to say where we'll be tomorrow?
[00:40.63]Well, my heart says no, but my mind says it's so

[01:27.72]Look out, baby, this is not what it seems
